patthana8.60:1.1: Nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana8.60:2.1: Nanabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana8.60:3.1: Nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca nanabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)
